title: Authority and Jurisdiction
publisher: UT Police Department / The University of Texas at Austin
relevance: Primary official source listing the named Austin-area sites UTPD patrols: Main Campus, J.J. Pickle Research Campus, Brackenridge tract, Paisano Ranch, and Bee Caves Research Center.
notes: Best current concise source for the core UTPD Austin-site footprint.

title: 2025 Annual Security and Fire Safety Report
publisher: The University of Texas at Austin
relevance: Official UT Austin security report stating UTPD has an MOU with APD, maintains liaison with Travis County, does not regularly patrol or post officers outside the Austin area, and relies on local law enforcement for separate campuses outside Austin and most non-campus properties.
notes: Core current source for distinguishing routine UTPD patrol from broader legal jurisdiction and from APD/TCSO geography.

title: Emergency Operations Plan 2025
publisher: The University of Texas at Austin
relevance: Official emergency plan listing all UT Austin campuses and marking only some with an asterisk as within UTPD jurisdiction; explicitly says other campuses rely on local city or county first responders.
notes: Strongest current source for rejecting both a broader UT Austin system row and any assumption that all Austin-based UT sites belong in the UTPD footprint.

title: Interactive Transparency Dashboards
publisher: UT Police Department / The University of Texas at Austin
relevance: Official UTPD page stating that areas west of campus are in Austin Police Department jurisdiction even though UTPD often responds to support APD, and that Dell Seton calls appear in UTPD data.
notes: Key current source for separating near-campus support activity from APD primary jurisdiction.

title: UTS 160 Jurisdiction of Commissioned Peace Officers
relevance: Official UT System policy summarizing Texas Education Code Section 51.203, stating primary jurisdiction includes all counties with UT-controlled property while each institution chief defines the principal law-enforcement focus within that area.
notes: Best legal-policy source for explaining why abstract statutory jurisdiction is broader than the actual production footprint.

title: UTAUS The University of Texas at Austin Police Department Report
publisher: The University of Texas System Office of Internal Audits
relevance: Official 2024 audit stating UTPD patrols all local UT Austin campus areas and patrols West Campus in a unique urban environment with numerous nearby police departments.
notes: Useful corroboration that the row is a campus-centered but not purely on-campus footprint.

title: UTPD Strategic Plan 2021-2026
publisher: UT Police Department / The University of Texas at Austin
relevance: Official UTPD planning document describing off-campus patrol districts and a bounded West Campus District 7 from the main campus border along Guadalupe to Rio Grande between 27th Street and Martin Luther King Jr. Boulevard.
notes: Supplementary source for the existence of a bounded near-campus patrol zone; use cautiously because later 2025 sources remain the best current authority.
